data.content_ref: inline:Compute a fragility profile for every accepted (IN) node by single-edge deletion: for each attack edge e targeting or defending the node, run the fixpoint on the graph minus e and record whether the node's label flips. Nodes invariant to every single-edge deletion are 'robust'; nodes that flip are 'fragile'. This is deterministic and polynomial — O(|E|) fixpoint runs, each linear — and read-only, so all four guarantees are preserved. The skeptical semantics hides that acceptance is a spectrum: a node can be IN while resting on exactly one attack edge whose removal flips it. Fragile accepted nodes become priority targets for additional defense warrants, strengthening the extension without altering its label function.
